product_one_liner.value: CyberCube provides cyber-risk modeling and analytics that help insurers, reinsurers and brokers quantify exposures, underwrite policies and manage portfolio risk.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or plans were found; commercial paths direct visitors to contact sales or request a demo.

named_customers.notes: Both appear on the homepage logo wall with links to announcements of their adoption of CyberCube products.

employee_band.notes: Reported counts of 117 and 114 employees both fall within this band.

founded_year.notes: Started within Symantec in 2015; launched as an independent company in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: Engineer-authored posts explain CyberCube’s Lambda-to-ECS migration and its AWS-based licensing and authorization architecture.

public_docs.notes: The public help page says all user resources are in a secured account; no public multi-article documentation portal is exposed.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The eight listed openings contain no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. Senior Data Engineer and Security Research Engineer do not meet the specified title criteria.

model_provider.notes: CEO Pascal Millaire publicly said CyberCube had employed OpenAI models and APIs since 2021; no specific model version was identified.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn records a $180 million Series D in October 2025. CyberCube’s October 1 announcement describes the Spectrum Equity investment as more than $180 million, so the numeric amount is not an exact total.

raised_18mo.notes: The investment of more than $180 million was announced on October 1, 2025, within the specified 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No SDR, BDR or account-executive opening is listed. The Senior Director, (Re)Insurance Sales role does not qualify.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest qualifying product-feature launch found was Broking Manager’s Regional Risk Transfer Benchmarking on May 5, 2026, before the May 9–November 9 window. The September I2T2 announcement concerns a research report and analytical framework, not an identified software-feature release.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On February 9, 2026, CyberCube announced Chris Methven as CEO, succeeding Pascal Millaire, who stepped down from the CEO role to become Senior Advisor.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor list explicitly identifies HubSpot for CRM, customer support, sales operations and account management.
